nodes.label: Latent flake: direct_rotation_is_zero_drop at its tolerance limit
nodes.rationale: Characterised rather than retried-until-green: clean isolated runs sit at gap 2, full-suite runs at gap 3 of an allowed 3, so container load — not the code under test — moves the number.

nodes.label: Do not widen the zero-drop tolerance
nodes.rationale: The assertion is the Cycle-4b make-before-break done-bar; a 4-packet gap may be a real regression and the point of the bar is that it is tight. Characterise isolated-vs-full-suite across several runs before touching anything.
